_comment: USER OVERRIDES ONLY for normalizedEntityKey (references/key-normalization.md). Keys are derived from the trusted ontologies first: the preferred label of the one class an entity's text denotes (scripts/json_to_ttl.py derive_key, via the trusted lexicon). The full generated variant->canonical table is `python -m scripts.concept_mapping export-synonyms` (trusted_ontologes/lexicon/key_synonyms.tsv.gz) — regenerated from whatever priority.md lists, never hand-kept. Add an entry here only for a variant no trusted ontology covers, or to redirect one it gets wrong; entries are reviewed and never removed, only redirected. Both sides in folded form (lowercase ASCII, single underscores).
_invariant_words: Words ending in -s that are NOT plurals; the fallback key algorithm never singularizes them.
